data.name: Fuwad
data.gender_notes: Fuwad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'fawadah' meaning 'a gift' or 'reward'. This name is often given to newborns as a reminder of the blessings and rewards bestowed upon them by Allah. The name Fuwad carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fuwad usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of Allah's blessings and rewards.
data.etymology: Fuwad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fuwad total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فواد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من ف و د، يعني القلب أو الفؤاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فواد مشتق من الجذر ف و د، و يعني القلب أو الفؤاد، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و ذكرت في سياق الحديث عن القلب و العقل، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحية و دينية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: فواد
in_urdu.meaning: دل کے معنی میں، قلب کی مرضی، اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: فواد نام کا مطلب دل یا قلب سے ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، یہ نام قلب کی صفائی اور روحانی معاملات میں اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फुवाद
in_hindi.meaning: दिल के अर्थ में, हृदय की पसंद, इस्लामी नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फुवाद नाम का अर्थ दिल या हृदय से है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है, यह नाम हृदय की पवित्रता और आध्यात्मिक मामलों में महत्व को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: فواد
in_pashto.meaning: د زړه په معنا، د قلب مرضي، اسلامي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: فواد نوم د زړه يا قلب څخه مشتق دی، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په اسلامي کلتور کې ډېر اهمیت لري، دا نوم د زړه پاکۍ او روحاني چارو کې اهمیت ښيي

in_english.name: Fuwad
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, means heart or soul

However, its meaning as a gift or reward suggests a sense of appreciation and gratitude towards the blessings of life. In a broader sense, it highlights the significance of family, community, and the role of Allah in granting us these blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Fuwad" serves as a constant reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon us by Allah. Ultimately, it is a name that embodies the belief that all blessings come from Allah and that we should be grateful for them.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Al-Futuh, 2:296. This source mentions Fuwad ibn 'Imru'l-Qais as the first man to convert to Islam in Kufa, Iraq, around 627 CE, during the time of the Prophet Muhammad.
historical_references.context: First convert to Islam in Kufa, Iraq.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Sa'd, Al-Tabaqat al-Kubra, 2:212. This reference states that Fuwad ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Abd Allah al-Asadi, also known as Fuwad ibn 'Imru'l-Qais, was a companion of the Caliph 'Ali ibn Abi Talib and a leader of the Shia during the early Islamic period, around 656-661 CE.
historical_references.context: Companion of Caliph 'Ali ibn Abi Talib and Shia leader.
